newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh expects stronger ties with Britain.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh expects stronger ties with Britain.

text.p: Bangladesh said on Friday it expected stronger ties with Britain following the Labour Party's landslide election victory.

"I confidently look towards a strengthening of the existing good relations and more meaningful cooperation (with Britain) in future," said State Minister for Foreign Affairs Abul Hasan Chowdhury in reaction to Tony Blair's election victory.
"I am naturally delighted to see the onward march of democracy in a country which serves as a model to many striving to institutionalise a parliamentary form of government," he told Reuters.
Bangladesh, formerly East Pakistan, was part of British India until independence in 1947.
